g.text: Libcuckoo: allocation placement and lock-algorithm effects

text.style: fill: #454545; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 32 workers. R = read percentage. Existing-key writes always succeed; universal ratios count attempts.

text.style: fill: #454545; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Placement: 3 existing-key / 8 universal rounds. Algorithms: 3 rounds; whiskers show paired min/max, not confidence intervals. Padding adds 28 MiB RSS.
